checks.title: Overusing client: directives

checks.howToFix:
Only hydrate components that need interactivity:


checks.howToFix:

```astro
---
// src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro
interface Props {
  title: string;
  description: string;
}
const { title, description } = Astro.props;
---
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width" />
    <title>{title}</title>
    <meta name="description" content={description} />
    <link rel="canonical" href={Astro.url} />
  </head>
  <body>
    <slot />
  </body>
</html>
```

checks.title: Django sitemap framework not configured
checks.description: Django has a built-in sitemap framework that should be used.
checks.howToFix:
Add sitemap to your project:

```python
# settings.py
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    'django.contrib.sitemaps',
]

# sitemaps.py
from django.contrib.sitemaps import Sitemap
from .models import Post

class PostSitemap(Sitemap):
    changefreq = "weekly"
    priority = 0.8

    def items(self):
        return Post.objects.filter(published=True)

    def lastmod(self, obj):
        return obj.updated_at

# urls.py
from django.contrib.sitemaps.views import sitemap
from .sitemaps import PostSitemap

sitemaps = {'posts': PostSitemap}

urlpatterns = [
    path('sitemap.xml', sitemap, {'sitemaps': sitemaps}),
]
```

checks.title: Client-side rendered React app detected
checks.description: React apps without SSR send empty HTML to crawlers. Search engines may not index your content.
checks.howToFix:
Option 1: Migrate to Next.js for automatic SSR/SSG
Option 2: Add prerendering with react-snap or prerender.io
Option 3: Use react-helmet-async with a prerender service

checks.title: Meta tags not server-rendered
checks.description: Title and meta description are set client-side and won't be seen by crawlers.
checks.howToFix:
For Vite/CRA: Use a prerender plugin or migrate to Next.js

Quick fix with vite-plugin-ssr:
```tsx
// pages/+Head.tsx
export function Head() {
  return <>
    <title>Your Title</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Your description" />
  </>
}
```

checks.title: Hydration mismatch detected
checks.description: Server HTML differs from client render, causing flicker and potential SEO issues.
checks.howToFix:
Common causes:
1. Using Date.now() or Math.random() in render
2. Browser-only APIs like window.localStorage
3. Different data on server vs client

Fix: Use useEffect for browser-only code:
```tsx
const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);
if (!mounted) return null; // or skeleton
```

checks.title: Using react-helmet instead of react-helmet-async
checks.description: react-helmet has memory leaks and doesn't work properly with SSR.

checks.title: React Router without server-side support
checks.description: Client-side routing breaks when crawlers access URLs directly.
checks.howToFix:
Ensure your server returns the same HTML for all routes.

For static hosting (Netlify, Vercel):
Add a redirect rule to serve index.html for all routes.

netlify.toml:
```toml
[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200
```

checks.title: React bundle too large
checks.description: Large JavaScript bundles delay interactivity and hurt Core Web Vitals.
checks.howToFix:
1. Use React.lazy() for code splitting:
```tsx
const HeavyComponent = React.lazy(() => import('./HeavyComponent'));

<Suspense fallback={<Loading />}>
  <HeavyComponent />
</Suspense>
```

2. Analyze bundle with source-map-explorer:
```bash
npm install source-map-explorer
npx source-map-explorer build/static/js/*.js
```

Add meta-tags to Gemfile:

```ruby
gem 'meta-tags'
```

Run `bundle install`, then:

```ruby
# app/views/layouts/application.html.erb
<head>

```

```ruby

set_meta_tags title: 'Page Title',
```

checks.title: Not using sitemap_generator gem
checks.description: sitemap_generator creates SEO-friendly sitemaps automatically.
checks.howToFix:
Add to Gemfile:

```ruby
gem 'sitemap_generator'
```

Generate config:
```bash
rails sitemap:install
```

Configure config/sitemap.rb:
```ruby
SitemapGenerator::Sitemap.default_host = "https://yoursite.com"

SitemapGenerator::Sitemap.create do
  add '/about', changefreq: 'monthly'
  Product.find_each do |product|
    add product_path(product), lastmod: product.updated_at
  end
end
```

Generate: `rails sitemap:refresh`

checks.title: Missing canonical URLs
checks.description: Rails apps with multiple URLs for same content need canonicals.
checks.howToFix:
Add canonical tag in layout:

```erb
<!-- Using meta-tags gem -->
<%= display_meta_tags canonical: request.original_url %>

<!-- Or manually -->
<link rel="canonical" href="<%= request.original_url.split('?').first %>" />
```

checks.title: Turbo may affect JavaScript-dependent crawlers
checks.description: Turbo Drive updates pages via JavaScript, which some crawlers may miss.
checks.howToFix:
For SEO-critical pages, ensure content is in initial HTML.

For dynamic content, add data-turbo="false":
```erb
<%= link_to 'Critical Page', critical_path, data: { turbo: false } %>
```

Or disable for specific pages:
```erb
<meta name="turbo-visit-control" content="reload">
```

checks.title: No structured data detected
checks.description: Add JSON-LD for rich snippets.
checks.howToFix:
Create a helper:

```ruby
# app/helpers/seo_helper.rb
module SeoHelper
  def json_ld(data)
    content_tag :script, data.to_json.html_safe,
                type: 'application/ld+json'
  end
end
```

Use in views:
```erb
<%= json_ld({
  "@context" => "https://schema.org",
  "@type" => "Product",
  "name" => @product.name,
  "description" => @product.description
}) %>
```

checks.title: N+1 queries may slow pages
checks.description: Slow pages hurt SEO. Use includes/eager_load.

checks.title: Page caching not configured
checks.description: Rails caching can dramatically improve response times.
checks.howToFix:
Enable caching in production:

```ruby
# config/environments/production.rb
config.action_controller.perform_caching = true
config.cache_store = :redis_cache_store, { url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] }
```

Use fragment caching:
```erb
<% cache @product do %>
  <%= render @product %>
<% end %>
```

checks.title: No SEO plugin detected
checks.description: WordPress benefits greatly from an SEO plugin like Yoast or Rank Math.
checks.howToFix:
Install an SEO plugin:

**Yoast SEO** (most popular):
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
2. Search "Yoast SEO"
3. Install and activate

**Rank Math** (feature-rich free tier):
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
2. Search "Rank Math"
3. Install and activate

Both provide:
- Meta title/description management
- XML sitemap generation
- Schema markup
- Content analysis

checks.title: WordPress core is outdated
checks.description: Running outdated WordPress is a security risk and may have SEO bugs.
checks.howToFix:
Update WordPress:
1. Backup your site first
2. Go to Dashboard > Updates
3. Click "Update Now"

Enable auto-updates in wp-config.php:
```php
define('WP_AUTO_UPDATE_CORE', true);
```

checks.title: No caching plugin detected

checks.howToFix:
Install a caching plugin:

**W3 Total Cache** (advanced):
- More features, steeper learning curve

**LiteSpeed Cache** (if on LiteSpeed server):

checks.title: Images not optimized
checks.description: Large images slow down WordPress significantly.
checks.howToFix:
Install an image optimization plugin:

**ShortPixel** or **Smush**:
- Compresses existing images
- Optimizes on upload
- WebP conversion

Or use Cloudflare Polish for automatic optimization.

checks.title: Too many plugins installed
checks.description: Each plugin adds overhead. Many sites have 30+ plugins when 10-15 suffice.
checks.howToFix:
Audit your plugins:
1. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins
2. Deactivate plugins not in use
3. Delete deactivated plugins
4. Consider consolidating (one SEO plugin, one security plugin)

Aim for under 20 plugins.

1. **ShortPixel**: Auto-converts and serves WebP
2. **WebP Express**: Converts and configures server

Or use Cloudflare with Polish enabled for automatic WebP.
